original.text: 1. 수료요건 중 재학연한 충족/ 등록금 납부를 충족하기 위한 등록

위 내용은 특수한 경우나 학생 개별 상황에 따라 달라질 수 있으니 정확한 판단이 어려우신 경우 학부 사무실에 다시 한 번 더 문의주시기 바랍니다.
● 문의: 전기정보공학부 행정실 박한수(hansoopark@snu.ac.kr)

english: 1. Registration to meet the 재학연한 (minimum period of enrolment) and tuition payment parts of the 수료요건 (course completion requirements)
- Please note that in this case, paying tuition for the regular semester is required, but 수강신청 (course registration) is optional.

- For example, if you have met all the master's course completion requirements but still need to register for a 4th time, because registering at least 4 times is a required condition, you do not need to register for courses when you register for the 4th time.
2. However, students who have exceeded the standard number of semesters (규정학기초과자) must register for courses.
- Students who have exceeded the standard number of semesters: from the 5th semester for master's and doctoral students, and from the 9th semester for integrated master's-doctoral students
- For example, if you are in your 5th semester of a master's programme, you must both register (pay tuition) and register for courses.
※ If you do not register for courses (earn credits) or take a leave of absence, you will be 제적 (expelled from the university).
3. Students with 초과자연구생 (research student status for students who have exceeded the standard number of semesters) must also register for courses.
4. [Regular enrolled students] who are not expected to complete their coursework or in the other cases described above must register (pay tuition) and register for courses.

The information above may differ in special cases or depending on each student's individual situation. If you are not sure what applies to you, please contact the department office again.
● Contact: 박한수 (Park Han-su), Administrative Office, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (hansoopark@snu.ac.kr)
